description: This file defines the class `BugreportParser` responsible for parsing Android bugreport text files. It includes regex patterns for section headers, manages section parsers, and provides methods to process the entire bugreport, extracting sections such as logs, VM traces, and metadata.

classes.name: BugreportParser
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing the entire bugreport file, managing section parsing, and storing parsed data into a Bugreport object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse lines of a bugreport into a Bugreport instance.

methods.name: parseSection
methods.description: Dispatches section lines to the appropriate section parser based on section name.
